英文第38題｜outlive的文意判讀

英文 / 綜合 / 綜合 · 首次出題日期：2026-09-08

分享原卷｜第 38 題

完整原題

作答所需文章／材料

Jessica read about Captain Eo, the oldest Magellanic penguin at the San Francisco Zoo & Gardens on the Internet yesterday. Sadly, it died in July 2022 at the age of 40. The penguin was well-known for being one of the oldest penguins in captivity. In 1984, Captain Eo arrived at the zoo with 51 other penguins. As time went on, Captain Eo outlived all of them and became the oldest Magellanic penguin in the zoo. When it was very old, it could not see or hear well and needed help with feeding. Under good care, Captain Eo lived a long life. In its lifetime, it had 26 children, 31 grandchildren and 8 great-grandchildren. After reading the news, Jessica looked up interesting facts about Magellanic penguins. Here are the notes. Interesting facts about Magellanic penguins… • They are birds. • They come from South America. • They are black and white. • They are about 70 cm tall and weigh 4 kg. • They are excellent swimmers. They are able to swim at 25 km an hour. • They live mainly on fish. • They live in groups. • They live for about 20 to 30 years. 字詞：penguin 企鵝；captivity 人工飼養；weigh 重。
What does “Captain Eo outlived all of them” mean in the reading? (A) Captain Eo lived near all of them. (B) Captain Eo lived longer than all of them. (C) Captain Eo died earlier than all the others. (D) Captain Eo lived far away from all of them.
先想一想，再查看答案、解說與原圖
原卷作答：D
正確答案：B。outlive 表示活得比別人久，與 lived longer than 同義。

逐項解析

選項與原句判讀句意與判斷理由
(A)
Captain Eo lived near all of them.		不選

near 表示住得近，文中比較的是壽命，不是居住距離。

(B)
Captain Eo lived longer than all of them.		應選

outlive 表示活得比別人久，與 lived longer than 同義。

(C)
Captain Eo died earlier than all the others.		不選

died earlier 表示比別人早死，與 outlived 的方向相反。

(D)
Captain Eo lived far away from all of them.		不選

far away 表示距離遠，並非活得比別人久。

詳細說明與解題步驟

一、由前後文找線索
Captain Eo 於1984年與另外51隻企鵝來到動物園，後來成為園內最年長的麥哲倫企鵝，表示牠活得比那一批其他企鵝久。

二、讀懂 outlive
outlive someone＝live longer than someone，即「比某人活得久」。此處 them 指另外51隻企鵝，不是所有種類的企鵝。

三、排除距離與相反意思
A、D 都把 live 理解成住在哪裡；C 說比較早死，則把方向倒轉。因此選 B。原卷選 D，應以後文 oldest 的年齡線索修正。

文章還提到一般壽命約20到30年，但 Captain Eo 活到40歲；這是壽命很長的個體，不代表每隻企鵝都能活到40歲。

這題要記住
